[[Al Ain FC|Al Ain]] 6–2 [[Al Wahda FC|Al Wahda]] (1 March 2018) | matches = 228 | total goals = 391 | average goals = 1.71 | longest wins = [[Al-Nasr SC (Dubai)|Al Nasr]] (6 games) | longest unbeaten = [[Al Ain FC|Al Ain]] (16 games) | longest winless = [[Al Dhafra FC|Al Dhafra]] (13 games) | longest losses = [[Emirates Club|Emirates]] (6 games) | highest attendance = [[Al Ain FC|Al Ain]] 6–2 [[Al Wahda FC|Al Wahda]] (20,786) | lowest attendance = [[Hatta Club|Hatta]] 1–2 [[Dibba Al Fujairah FC|Dibba Al Fujairah]] (501) | average attendance = 418 | prevseason = [[2016–17 UAE Pro-League|2016–17]] | nextseason = [[2018–19 UAE Pro-League|2018–19]] | updated = }} The '''2017–18 [[UAE Pro League]]''' was the 43rd season of top-level football in the [[United Arab Emirates]].{{cite web|title=New League name announced by H.E. Mohammed Thani Murshed Al Romaithi - News - UAE Pro League Committee|url=http://www.uae.agleague.ae/en/news/new-name.html|language=en}} [[Al Jazira Club|Al-Jazira]] are the defending champions after winning their second title last season. [[Ajman Club|Ajman]] and [[Dubai CSC|Dubai]] both got promoted on 22 April 2017 after beating [[Fujairah FC|Fujairah]] 3–2 and [[Ras Al Khaima Club|Ras Al Khaimah]] 2–0. On 3 May 2017, [[Baniyas Club|Baniyas]] were the first team to get relegated from [[2016–17 UAE Pro League|2016–17 season]] after drawing 4–4 against [[Emirates Club|Emirates]]. [[Ittihad Kalba FC|Ittihad Kalba]] were the last team to get relegated after losing to [[Al Ain FC|Al-Ain]] 2–1 and both [[Emirates Club|Emirates]] and [[Dibba Al Fujairah FC|Dibba Al-Fujairah]] didn't lose in the same week. In July 2017, [[Shabab Al Ahli Club|Al Ahli]], [[Al Shabab Al Arabi Club (Dubai)|Al Shabab]] and [[Dubai CSC|Dubai]] merged to form [[Shabab Al Ahli Club|Shabab Al Ahli Dubai]]. On 20 April 2018, [[Hatta Club|Hatta]] lost to [[Al Wasl F.C.|Al Wasl]] 2–0 and were the first team to get relegated. On 21 April 2018, [[Al Ain FC|Al Ain]] were crowned champions for the 13th time after destroying [[Al Nasr SC (Dubai)|Al Nasr]] 4–0. On the final day, [[Emirates Club|Emirates]] were relegated after drawing against [[Al-Nasr SC (Dubai)|Al Nasr]] 2–2. In May 2012, it was decided that since the league needs 14 teams for next season,{{cite news |title=14 teams for next UAE Pro-League |url=https://www.khaleejtimes.com/sports/local-sports/14-teams-for-next-uae-pro-league |access-date= |publisher=Khaleejtimes |date=4 June 2012}} the bottom two teams of this season would have to face 3rd and 4th-placed team of the 2nd division to see who will secure spots for next season. ==Stadia and locations==
